# Legacy Office fixtures

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

- `word-extractor-test01.doc` is the non-sensitive `test01.doc` fixture from
  `morungos/node-word-extractor` commit
  `d971d9f69056245ae129bd2ce31436d518293854`, redistributed under that
  repository's MIT license. SHA-256:
  `3aefb1a8370ede7cc3aef1280fe216e9597e2a458a3125bd55dd735109407f33`.
- `document-extraction-sample.xls` is the synthetic Excel 97-2003 fixture from
  the signed skill-suite tests. It proves that sharing the OLE compound-file
  header is not enough to classify a file as Word.
